page.title: Welcome
page.purpose: Orient an operator to the install decision and provide an explicit entry into capability selection.

priorities.statement: The operator understands that onboarding configures the install before any changes are applied.
The entry action is obvious and keyboard accessible.

states.description: Welcome message and setup entry action render.

elements.description: Orientation content for the onboarding flow.

journeys.description: A new operator can enter the onboarding wizard from the welcome route.

responsive.mobile: The orientation remains readable and the entry action remains reachable without horizontal scrolling.
responsive.desktop: The orientation is centered with a clear primary entry action.

accessibility: The page has one level-one heading.
The entry action is keyboard reachable with an accessible name.

required: A browser workflow opens /setup/welcome and observes the welcome content and entry action.
